stem:
Lalit labels the corners of a rectangle A, B, C, D in order going around the boundary. A valid name may start at any corner and then follow that travel order.

Which name is valid for that rectangle?

options.text: Rectangle ACDB, listing corners by jumping across instead of travelling the boundary.
Only rectangle ABCD is allowed; starting at any other corner makes the name invalid.
Rectangle ABCD is valid only after renaming the corners in alphabetical order first.
Rectangle BCDA is valid: it lists corners in boundary travel order, starting at B.

teacher.key_rationale: A valid name lists corners in travel order around the boundary; any start is fine, so BCDA works. Diagonal-style jump ACDB fails travel order. Requiring a start at A omits that any corner may start. Forcing alphabetical renaming is outside this naming hinge.

mx_swap.reason: Reversing order-of-travel→labels as a production story is weaker than jump-listing, fixed-start omission, and alphabetical scope error; kept those three.
